history.summary: The principal ISKCON temple in Vijayawada, formally the Sri Jagannath Mandir, located at Skew Bridge, Satya Narayana Nagar, Ramalingeswara Nagar. Its deities and architecture are modeled on the Jagannath Puri tradition, with Jagannath, Baladeva and Subhadra as the presiding deities. The center runs kirtans, discourses, prasadam distribution, a book stall and a goshala, and offers simple accommodation for pilgrims. Note: a separate ISKCON center, the Radha Syam Sundar Mandir, exists at Tadepalle across the river -- the CSV's generic name is documented here as the main Vijayawada temple (verify intended referent). The temple's own festival calendar was not published; festivals listed are the standard ISKCON observances. Coordinates are from a map listing for the Vijayawada ISKCON temple and are approximate.

name: ISKCON Temple
town_description: Vijayawada is a major city in NTR district on the banks of the Krishna river, and Andhra Pradesh's principal commercial and transport hub. It is known for the Kanaka Durga temple on Indrakeeladri hill, the Prakasam Barrage, and its role as a rail junction connecting South India.

travel.airport: Vijayawada International Airport at Gannavaram (about 20 km from the city)
travel.railway: Vijayawada Junction (a few km; city transport available)
travel.road: Located at Skew Bridge, Ramalingeswara Nagar; well connected by city buses, autos and taxis within Vijayawada

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Janmashtami and Rath Yatra for festival visits; Sunday feast program weekly
visitor_information.opening_hours: 7:30 AM-1:00 PM and 4:30-8:00 PM daily, per visitor listings; early-morning harathi reported from around 4 AM on some days -- verify before visiting
